content.niche: AI influencer and AI video workflow education
content.audience: creators, AI video operators, agencies and founders who want repeatable video generation
content.offer_or_cta: comment keyword to receive a small guide

analysis.first_two_seconds: Direct value promise: get the prompt or scene structure behind any AI video.
analysis.hook_line_or_visual_summary: The creator frames a common pain: seeing a strong AI video and wasting credits trying to recreate the prompt.
analysis.narrative_shape: pain -> trick found -> tool stack -> workflow steps -> proof by repeated testing -> comment keyword CTA
scene_beats: open with the problem of recreating a good AI video
position the method as a credit-saving shortcut
use Gemini to analyze the reference video by scenes
use ChatGPT or Claude to rewrite the prompt for your own character
use Seedance 2.0 through Higgsfield or Magnific to generate
close with comment keyword for guide
analysis.camera_behavior: creator-led vertical explainer mixed with AI tool/workflow references
analysis.cut_rhythm: fast educational cuts; each tool has a specific job
analysis.subtitle_style: short Spanish captions and tool names; likely bold, high contrast and mobile-first
analysis.audio_style: creator explainer; do not reuse exact audio
analysis.proof_mechanism: names specific tools and explains the role of each tool in the chain

metadata_observed.caption_summary: Explains a workflow: use Gemini to break down a reference video into scenes, use ChatGPT or Claude to adapt the prompt to your AI character, and use Seedance 2.0 through Higgsfield or Magnific. Ends with a comment keyword for a guide.

workflow_extracted.name: Reference video to original AI prompt
steps: Choose a reference video only as inspiration.
Ask Gemini to decompose the video by scenes, camera, movement, mood and transitions.
Use ChatGPT or Claude to rewrite the structure for an original ONIA/client character.
Generate with Seedance 2.0 or a comparable video model through an approved platform.
Review for copy risk, brand fit and claim safety before publishing.
workflow_extracted.onia_use: Turn client references into original Higgsfield prompts and Video Lab briefs without copying the creator, face, wording, music or exact edit.

usable_patterns: make the first sentence a direct pain creators/operators have
turn a tool chain into a simple 3-step system
explain each tool by its job, not by hype
use a comment keyword when offering a guide, checklist or audit
show the reference-to-original transformation as the proof
onia_adaptation.sample_onia_hook: Vi un video IA brutal y en vez de copiarlo lo converti en un sistema para crear uno original.
onia_adaptation.sample_higgsfield_prompt_block: Create a vertical 9:16 workflow explainer showing a founder reviewing an AI video reference, breaking it into scene cards, rewriting it into an original ONIA prompt, and generating a clean business video. Fast cuts, screen overlays, Spanish captions, practical tone, no copied creator likeness or exact sequence.
onia_adaptation.adaptation_notes: Use this as a production method, not as a content identity. It is useful for ONIA because it converts inspiration into original prompts and reduces wasted generation credits.

not_useful_or_use_with_care: Do not sell this as copying any video.
Do not imply ONIA can clone creators, faces, voices or copyrighted styles.
Do not use creator keywords or community CTA as-is.
Exact tool names can change; preserve the workflow, not the dependency.
notes: Very useful for ONIA/Higgsfield because it defines a practical reference-decomposition workflow. Main risk is accidentally framing the process as copying; always present it as inspiration-to-original-production.
